speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your specific symptoms regarding the gait and limb ataxia, and tell me about your significant medical history. We have ten questions available for this consultation.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing the "drunken" gait and the clumsiness on your right side; does this ataxia occur only when you walk, or is it also present when your arms and legs are at rest? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your vision, hearing, or sensation in your limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) due to natalizumab therapy in a patient with Crohn's disease.
